svg.text: A forecasting pipeline that collects daily market data, builds
features from price and volume history, and trains time series
models to estimate short term price movement. Predictions are
served through an API and compared against real prices on a
Scheduled ingestion and cleaning of historical OHLCV data into SQL
Features such as moving averages, RSI, volatility and volume trends
LSTM and gradient boosting models evaluated with walk-forward
Backtesting plus a dashboard that tracks forecast error over time
